posts.cooked:
I am posting a video EVERY day this week (Monday-Saturday) about Sentinels of the Multiverse!

I will likely die from the amount of content I am making for this week. It will be worth watching... Sort of.

Monday: An Announcement video to share and get the folks excited.

Tuesday-Friday: I will be finishing my series explaining all of the Villains in Sentinels (So far, obviously no WotC)

Saturday: Finally, our review of SotM. We've waited for a while on this one... Let's see if it was worth the wait.

Here are the videos as they emerge:

Monday- Announcement video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kj1ezFvl_lI

Tuesday- Room, I mean Rook City Villains video: http://youtu.be/CDtJ-2n-YHs (Corrections, Matriarch and Tacyhon are Cousins. Spite is neither confirmed nor denied to be a cannibal.)

Wednesday- Intestinal Frolics (Infernal Relics) video: http://youtu.be/jlaA3MCQS4Y (Corrections, Citizen Truth broke Absolution. Also, Apostate didn't rip Fanatic's wing off. I just envisioned that as he throw her to the ground, crumpled with doubt and fear, he tore her wing off to add insult to injury. He didn't and I apologize for inserting my own take on some of these interactions to these videos.)

Thursday- Smathered Lovelimes (Shattered Timelines) video: http://youtu.be/Ed44MBGq-8c (Correction, Iron Legaxy has 32 HP)

Friday- Vegetables (Vengeance) video: http://youtu.be/8xip4n69fI4 (Corrections, read the Youtube description to understand why the video is so poor in editing and quality. Thank you for watching and your support folks, it's been worth the work knowing people were watching.)

Stay tuned and thanks for watching.
